SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) AS script_id, s.display_title, CAST(s.current_version_id AS CHAR) AS current_version_id, v.version_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM av_script_version vc WHERE vc.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND vc.script_id = s.id) AS version_count, v.source_type, v.effective_character_count, v.estimated_duration_seconds, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(v.script_text) > 120 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(v.script_text, 120), '…') ELSE v.script_text END AS preview, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM av_user_script s JOIN av_script_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.owner_type = 'personal' AND s.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND s.deleted = '0'
AND s.display_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{orderByColumn} = 'displayTitle' AND #{isAsc} = 'asc' THEN s.display_title END ASC, CASE WHEN #{orderByColumn} = 'displayTitle' AND #{isAsc} = 'desc' THEN s.display_title END DESC, CASE WHEN #{orderByColumn} = 'updatedAt' AND #{isAsc} = 'asc' THEN s.updated_at END ASC, CASE WHEN #{orderByColumn} = 'updatedAt' AND #{isAsc} = 'desc' THEN s.updated_at END DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT * FROM av_user_script WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'personal' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND deleted = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE av_user_script SET current_version_id = #{versionId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'personal' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND created_by_user_id = #{actorId} AND deleted = '0'

UPDATE av_user_script SET display_title = #{displayTitle}, current_version_id = #{versionId}, script_revision = script_revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'personal' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND current_version_id = #{parentVersionId} AND script_revision = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted = '0'

UPDATE av_user_script SET deleted = '1', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = 'personal' AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND created_by_user_id = #{actorId} AND deleted = '0'
